name: Pirate Night: King George's Roasted Strip Loin
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Pirate Night Menu
searchKeywords: king georges roasted privateer strip loin
whyItWorks: While Pirate Night features spicy Tia Dalma's Jerk Chicken and fibrous stir-fries, the Roasted Privateer Strip Loin with mashed/roasted potatoes is a safe, mild anchor.
prepOrOrderInstructions: On Pirate Night, order King George's Strip Loin (or the Lighter Note baked salmon/chicken) with plain mashed potatoes or white rice, and finish with the Pirates Treasure Sundae (vanilla ice cream & caramel, skip rum cake/pineapple if sensitive). Avoid the spicy Jerk Chicken.
watchOuts: Tia Dalma's Jerk Chicken (habanero/scotch bonnet chili heat)
